name: More Provident Funds Ltd
summary: More Provident Funds Ltd., an Israeli enterprise specializing in provident fund administration, supplies a diverse range of long-term savings solutions. Its offerings encompass traditional savings and welfare-focused provident funds, investment-oriented provident funds, educational savings vehicles, and specific savings schemes designed for children. Established in 2013, the company operates from its main office situated in Ramat Gan, Israel.
